In level 1, I never clicked a gray directly (except the swap). Hmm, actually the second click was on the gray and caused a swap.
Maybe the general rule is: clicking any diamond moves it to the click point; the midpoint payload follows the midpoint of the two diamonds of its rope. So in level 2, the white diamond (6,17) is the movable one. The orange diamond is... a second anchor? And the gray diamonds are anchors.

Wait. Maybe the lines are physical ropes: the white diamond is tied to the orange diamond, which is tied to the grays. When the white moves, the rope pulls...
